applicable_when: The kernel is severely underutilized: only 0.23 waves/SM (90 blocks on 132 SMs), achieved occupancy 6.25% vs theoretical 18.75%, and 168 registers/thread limiting blocks/SM to 3. The tl.dot call uses ALLOW_TF32=False, meaning it falls back to FP32 FFMA at 67 TFLOPS instead of Tensor Cores at 989 TFLOPS (FP32 Tensor) on the H200. Enabling TF32 (ALLOW_TF32=True) routes tl.dot through Tensor Core MMA instructions, delivering ~8x compute throughput. K=192 is well below the 512 threshold where TF32 mantissa truncation (23->10 bits) would cause accumulated error exceeding atol=1e-3, making this precision trade-off safe.
